Company Financial Data
Source: SEC EDGAR CompanyFacts API
Raw data: company_financials_raw.csv
Clean data: company_financials_clean.csv
The dataset includes 40 publicly traded companies across 8 sectors, with key financial metrics for the most recent fiscal year (10-K filing). Derived metrics include ROA, ROE, debt-to-equity, and profit margin.

title: Data Preparation and Exploratory Data Analysis
text:
The primary dataset comes from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) EDGAR system, using the CompanyFacts API. This API provides standardized XBRL financial statement data for publicly traded companies without requiring an API key. We selected 40 large companies across eight sectors to ensure diversity.
Other data sources (macroeconomic indicators, market data, news sentiment) will be added in subsequent steps.

  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Sector", y = "Return on Assets", title = "ROA Distribution by Sector") +
  theme_minimal() +

title: Introduction
text:
What factors are associated with differences in the financial performance of publicly traded companies?



Financial performance and risk are influenced by a combination of company-specific, industry, market, and macroeconomic characteristics. This project uses machine learning and data science methods to investigate relationships among these factors.



This project will:

Collect financial, economic, market, and other relevant data.
Clean and prepare the data for analysis.
Explore patterns and relationships using data visualization.
Apply multiple machine learning methods.
Compare the results across methods.
Identify important factors associated with financial performance and risk.




To be completed after data collection.



The project will apply:

Clustering
Association Rule Mining (ARM)
Naive Bayes
Decision Trees
Support Vector Machines (SVMs)
Regression
Neural Networks
